public_properties.title: Sample Elmwood Village Colonial
public_properties.description: Sample listing for demonstration. A four-bedroom colonial layout typical of Buffalo's Elmwood Village: a front porch, a living room with a fireplace, hardwood floors, an updated eat-in kitchen, and a fenced backyard with a detached garage.

public_properties.title: Sample North Buffalo Craftsman Bungalow
public_properties.description: Coming Soon sample listing. A three-bedroom craftsman-style bungalow near a neighborhood commercial strip, with original-style woodwork, a refreshed kitchen, and a finished lower level.

public_properties.title: Sample Cheektowaga Brick Ranch
public_properties.description: Sample listing for demonstration. An everyday three-bedroom brick ranch with one-floor living, a well-kept original kitchen, a full basement, and a deep backyard.

public_properties.title: Sample Kenmore Two-Story Home
public_properties.description: Sample listing for demonstration. A three-bedroom two-story home on a tree-lined village street, with a front porch, a bright living room, a renovated kitchen, and a partially finished basement.

public_properties.title: Sample Town of Tonawanda Cape Cod
public_properties.description: Coming Soon sample listing. A three-bedroom Cape Cod with a first-floor bedroom, two full baths, and a fenced yard. Price to be announced in this example.

public_properties.title: Sample Renovated Orchard Park Colonial
public_properties.description: Sample listing for demonstration. A renovated four-bedroom colonial with an open kitchen and island, a family room with a fireplace, a primary suite, a deck, and an attached two-car garage.

public_properties.title: Sample Hamburg Split-Level
public_properties.description: Sample listing for demonstration. A three-bedroom split-level with a lower-level family room, an updated bath, a patio, and a large backyard.

public_properties.title: Sample Williamsville Townhouse
public_properties.description: Coming Soon sample listing. A two-bedroom townhouse with an open main floor, two primary-style bedrooms, an attached garage, and association-maintained grounds.
